2608.18820.title: Pairwise Logical Selection of Enthymeme Completions under Semantic-Link Uncertainty
2608.18820.paper_summary: Arguments often omit premises or claims, forming enthymemes. We study pairwise logical selection between two candidates for the omitted component. Existing natural language methods can identify or generate candidates but often do not expose how the selected candidate completes the inference, while logic-based approaches usually assume that the required formulae and background knowledge are available. We extend a prior neuro-symbolic pipeline from missing-premise to missing-claim selection and replace binary entailment outcomes with logical-resistance scores. Top-Link uses weighted Partial MaxSAT under a single configuration of highest-confidence semantic links. We then introduce Possible-World Atom-Link Formalization (PWAL), which keeps translated formulae fixed and marginalizes logical resistance over alternative cross-formula semantic-link configurations. We evaluate PWAL on five tasks: ARCT and a CDED-derived task for missing-premise selection, iDebate- and AAE2-derived tasks for missing-claim selection, and alphaNLI for abductive hypothesis selection. Relative to Top-Link, PWAL raises strict accuracy by 2.95-30.86 percentage points and reduces tie rates by 4.57-58.00 percentage points on all five tasks. When ties receive half credit, accuracy still increases by 0.45-6.04 percentage points. PWAL also records the translated formulae, sampled link configurations, and resistance components for every comparison, providing a transparent trace of each score.
2608.18820.paper_summary_zh: 論證經常省略前提或主張，形成隱含命題。我們研究兩個候選者之間的成對邏輯選擇，以填補省略的組件。現有的自然語言方法可以識別或生成候選者，但通常不會揭示所選候選者如何完成推理，而基於邏輯的方法通常假設所需的公式和背景知識是可用的。我們將先前的神經符號管道從缺失前提擴展到缺失主張的選擇，並用邏輯抵抗分數替換二元蕴涵結果。Top-Link 在單一配置的最高置信度語義鏈下使用加權的部分最大滿足問題（Partial MaxSAT）。然後，我們引入可能世界原子鏈接形式化（PWAL），該形式化保持翻譯公式不變，並對替代的跨公式語義鏈配置進行邏輯抵抗的邊際化。我們在五個任務上評估 PWAL：ARCT 和一個基於 CDED 的缺失前提選擇任務，iDebate 和 AAE2 衍生的缺失主張選擇任務，以及 alphaNLI 用於推論假設選擇。相對於 Top-Link，PWAL 在所有五個任務上將嚴格準確率提高了 2.95-30.86 個百分點，並將平局率降低了 4.57-58.00 個百分點。當平局獲得半分時，準確率仍然增加了 0.45-6.04 個百分點。PWAL 還記錄了翻譯公式、抽樣鏈接配置和每次比較的抵抗組件，提供了每個分數的透明追蹤。
2608.18820.author: Xuyao Feng et.al.
